title: The Further Charge Added Where a Package's Balance Has Moved On
content:
Where a package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products has already reached or passed the day its balance falls due, the suppliers have been paid, and a further charge is added to the amendment charge's starting amount. The day the balance falls due is the one recorded against the package itself.

1. **The due day has passed.** Where the day the balance falls due on the package has passed, the product's cancellation administration charge is added to the starting amount for every traveller on the package, the suppliers having been paid by then and the change being priced as a cancellation and a rebooking.
2. **The due day has not passed, but the balance has begun to be taken.** Where the day the balance falls due on the package has not passed and the package ledger already carries an instalment of the balance — at least 1 such line standing on it — the product's cancellation administration charge is added to the starting amount once for the package.
3. **Neither.** Where the day the balance falls due has not passed and the package ledger carries no instalment of the balance at all, nothing is added to the starting amount under this note.

## Both sides of the day

The day the balance falls due is read against the day the change is being handled. On the due day itself the due day has not passed, so the first clause does not answer and the second decides according to whether an instalment of the balance stands on the ledger. On the day after the due day the due day has passed, and the charge is added for every traveller.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A package recording 3 travellers, whose balance fell due a week ago, on a product whose cancellation administration charge is 75.00 USD per traveller, has 225.00 USD added to the starting amount.

The same package, its balance not yet due and 1 instalment already standing on its ledger, has 75.00 USD added — once for the package, not once for each of the 3 travellers.

The same package again, its balance not yet due and no instalment yet taken, has nothing added.
